title: Design the general modem core API
description:
Define the public modem abstractions that separate constellation geometry, bit labeling, mapping, demapping, and channel integration. This story establishes the shared surface that all later modem work will build on.

## Background

The current modem code is split across BPSK-specific AWGN helpers, a QPSK-only modulation module, and a fading wrapper that embeds QPSK assumptions. Before adding higher-order QAM or custom constellations, the crate needs a single batch-oriented modem API that can support both arbitrary research constellations and optimized built-in presets.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Public types and traits for constellations, bit mappings, and batched modulation and demodulation are defined.
- [ ] The API supports arbitrary user-defined constellations and labelings, plus validated built-in presets.
- [ ] The accelerator boundary is batch-oriented and does not leak backend-specific details into high-level code.
- [ ] Compatibility adapters required for the current simulation entry points are identified in the design.

## Notes

This story should anchor the type and trait design for the follow-on reference path, Gray-QAM fast path, and simulation integration work.
